author: Y. S. Coker
title: Katrina Pierson posts series of comments expressing concerns and reactions on social media
text:
Katrina Pierson, a Republican who was elected to the Texas State House in 2025 representing the state’s 33rd House district, posted several comments on her social media account on May 20, 2026.
In a post from the early morning, Pierson wrote: “Great news! https://t.co/MWiW4zMvnP” (May 20, 2026). Later that day, she followed up with a brief statement: “Nope! https://t.co/zcI5ZHwvlG” (May 20, 2026).
In another message posted in the afternoon, Pierson expressed concern about public behavior regarding women and children. She stated: “Great!! I have very serious concerns. It is very disturbing when you see people “causally” watching women and children from a distance while wearing them. https://t.co/scDp1eiWYH” (May 20, 2026).
Pierson assumed office after winning her seat in the Texas State House for District 33 in 2025, succeeding Justin Holland.
